hypotheses.quote: A given quantity of metal is to be cast into a half cylinder

quotes.goal: the total surface area is minimum when the ratio of the length of the cylinder to the diameter of its semi-circular ends is π : (π + 2)

note: Radius r, length L, fixed volume V = πr²L/2. Surface: two semicircular ends πr², curved surface πrL, rectangular base 2rL.
